about_the_game:
Wota x Deduction x Training

This is a narrative-driven mystery adventure game with character training elements.

You will take on the role of the protagonist, Wada, steadily improving your abilities through daily part-time work, writing, watching idol performances, gaming and other pursuits. By deepening friendships with wota friends who have diverse attributes and gathering clues, uncover the truth behind a series of incidents in the idol wota world.

★Daily Life

Experience and plan daily schedules from the perspectives of three different identifies: a part-time pizza delivery man, a mystery novelist, and an idol wota. Develop ability improvement strategies within monthly time constraints to tackle diverse goals.

★Friendship

Each wota friends has their own unique wota attributes, and as their friendship with the protagonist deepens, they will provide clues corresponding to them. These clues will become pivotal to resolving various cases. Simultaneously, the individual stories of each friend will gradually unfold.

★Deduction

It's not just the main storyline; life will throw all sorts of troubles your way that need solving. But don't fret—you, our protagonist, are a brilliant mystery novelist (self-proclaimed). Though your novel sales aren't exactly booming, there's always a way, isn't there?

Features

  • Pixel art style

  • Rich character and narrative experience

  • Various game memes (?

  • Wota Life Simulation (x

Other Information

This demo version is estimated to take approximately 4 to 5 hours to complete, covering the first two cases of the game.

Please note that the demo version does not support Steam achievements, and save files are not compatible with the full version.

As the latest title in the MWLC series, the story timeline is set one year before the main story of MWLC.

But even if you haven't played MWLC, it won't affect your enjoyment of this title.
